description: Source code for managing Wi-Fi access point configurations via hostapd, including functions for updating beacons, reloading security keys, managing neighbors, setting parameters, and configuring security modes.

methods.name: s_sendHostapdCommand
methods.description: Sends a command to hostapd for a specific access point, checking response for 'OK'.

methods.name: wld_ap_hostapd_updateBeacon
methods.description: Updates the beacon frame for an access point, possibly redirecting to main VAP.

methods.name: wld_ap_hostapd_reloadSecKey
methods.description: Reloads the WPA pre-shared keys configuration on hostapd.

methods.name: wld_ap_hostapd_dumpNeighborList
methods.description: Dumps the list of neighboring stations to a provided list.

methods.name: wld_ap_hostapd_removeNeighbor
methods.description: Removes a neighbor station from hostapd's neighbor list.

methods.name: wld_ap_hostapd_setNeighbor
methods.description: Sets (adds) a neighbor station in hostapd.

methods.name: wld_ap_hostapd_setParamValue
methods.description: Sets a parameter value in hostapd for an access point.

methods.name: wld_ap_hostapd_sendCommand
methods.description: Sends a generic command to hostapd.

methods.name: wld_ap_hostapd_getParamAction
methods.description: Retrieves the 'on change' action for a specific hostapd parameter.

methods.name: wld_ap_hostapd_setParamAction
methods.description: Sets the 'on change' action for a specific hostapd parameter.

methods.name: wld_ap_hostapd_setSsid
methods.description: Sets the SSID in hostapd configuration for an access point.

methods.name: s_ap_hostapd_setSecretKeyExt
methods.description: Updates secret keys in hostapd configuration based on security mode.

methods.name: wld_ap_hostapd_setSecretKey
methods.description: Updates secret keys in hostapd configuration for an access point.

methods.name: s_ap_hostapd_setSecurityModeExt
methods.description: Sets security mode parameters in hostapd configuration.

methods.name: wld_ap_hostapd_setSecurityMode
methods.description: Sets security mode in hostapd for an access point.

methods.name: wld_ap_hostapd_setSecParams
methods.description: Configures security parameters in hostapd for an access point.

methods.name: wld_ap_hostapd_setSSIDAdvertisement
methods.description: Enables or disables SSID broadcast in hostapd.

methods.name: wld_ap_hostapd_setMaxNbrSta
methods.description: Sets maximum number of stations in hostapd.
